TipsSection.title: Useful Tips
TipsSection.description: Choose a category to receive personalized recommendations for improving your well-being.

breathing_478.title: 4-7-8 Breathing
breathing_478.text: A natural way to fall asleep: inhale for 4s, hold for 7s, exhale for 8s.

breathing_box.title: Box Breathing
breathing_box.text: A technique for focus and calm: inhale, hold, exhale, and pause—all for 4 seconds each.

breathing_deep.title: Deep Relaxation
breathing_deep.text: A slow inhale through the nose and a maximal long exhale through the mouth to calm the heart.

breathing_lion.title: Lion's Breath
breathing_lion.text: A powerful exhale with an open mouth. Best for relieving stress and facial muscle tension.

breathing_alternate.title: Alternate Nostril Breathing
breathing_alternate.text: Breathing through the left and right nostrils alternately to balance emotions and logic.

breathing_diaphragm.title: Belly Breathing
breathing_diaphragm.text: Activate the diaphragm for deep oxygen exchange and internal organ massage.
